Licking County: Granville, Heath, Johnstown & Pataskala

Explore seven selections across Licking County, grouped by town: Denison and Raccoon Valley in Granville, Mastodon in Heath, Echo Springs, Clover Valley and Kyber Run in Johnstown, and Cumberland Trail in Pataskala. Compare each location separately, then review the selected rates or booking prices for your planned round.

7 selections from Tee Drop’s directory, not an exhaustive county list. This regional guide groups distinct towns; prices and booking terms vary by course.
